## Trajectory

- **7d: 7 items closed, 508k output tokens.** The whole product line is four days old.
- **Three honest negatives and one result.** That is a healthy ratio for a research arc
  and it is the reason the arc has direction: the $S^3$ route was killed cheaply
  (mg-aedf, mg-8d74 at 185k/188k) rather than expensively, and the replacement frame
  arrived for 77k.
- **The standing test is doing real work.** "Is any statement false for $-W_\lambda$?"
  killed the entire $S^3$ chain and two of mg-8599's own five candidates — including
  candidates the same note had generated. A test that its author turns on their own
  output is worth keeping.
- **Bottleneck: definitions, not proofs.** Both blockers above are one paragraph of
  writing, and both have been open since mg-8888 flagged the ill-posed lemma on
  2026-08-11. Nothing downstream can be scoped precisely until they close. This is the
  single thing most worth Daniel's attention.
- **Risk on the record: the ceiling may be lower than the mandate.** mg-8599 establishes
  that the repaired involution route coincides with Connes' own formulation, and that the
  one place a sign is actually proved (C2) is a real theorem but not a route to RH. The
  likely honest outcome of this arc is a sharp, publishable repositioning of the corpus
  against Connes–Consani. mg-3a9c is what turns that from a suspicion into a finding.
